name: BookStack
description: Wiki that keeps your documentation in shelves, books, chapters and pages

paths.name: Config
paths.description: Everything: the MariaDB database (mysql), uploaded files and images (www), backups, and .app_key, this install's own key made on first start. Back it up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: BookStack web UI, published on host as 6758

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: The user id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: The group id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.

variables.name: APP_URL
variables.description: Leave it empty and BookStack uses the address in your browser. Set it when you open BookStack through a domain, like https://wiki.example.com, so links in emails point there.

variables.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: The password for the first admin, admin@admin.com. Leave it empty and one is made for you: it is shown in the app's logs, in the box marked CREDENTIALS. Only used once; change it later in BookStack itself.
